name: Help Me If You Can
tagline: Post a task, fund it with a stablecoin, and get matched to an expert who is paid on the ledger.
problem: Getting quick expert review of work in an unfamiliar area is slow and uncertain.
solution: Tasks are funded with RLUSD or XRP, AI matches candidates, and payment settles on XRPL.
demo_moment: Team-described: post a code-review task and pay the reviewer on completion.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Ripple: Best in Ledger Award” among 261 submissions.
Deliberately tried a new stablecoin to push its use.

lessons: Using the sponsor's newest product can stand out.
